MainComponents.name: Fuel Tank
MainComponents.description: Stores fuel and supplies it to the engine via fuel lines.

MainComponents.name: Fuel Pump
MainComponents.description: Pumps fuel from the tank to the engine under pressure.

MainComponents.name: Fuel Filter
MainComponents.description: Removes dirt and impurities from the fuel before injection.

MainComponents.name: Fuel Lines
MainComponents.description: Carries fuel from the tank to the engine and return flow.

MainComponents.name: Fuel Rail
MainComponents.description: Distributes pressurized fuel evenly to each injector.

FuelDeliveryAndInjection.name: Fuel Injector
FuelDeliveryAndInjection.description: Sprays atomized fuel into the combustion chamber or intake port.

FuelDeliveryAndInjection.name: Fuel Pressure Regulator
FuelDeliveryAndInjection.description: Maintains constant fuel pressure in the system.

FuelDeliveryAndInjection.name: Fuel Return Line
FuelDeliveryAndInjection.description: Returns excess fuel from the rail back to the tank.

FuelDeliveryAndInjection.name: Fuel Pressure Sensor
FuelDeliveryAndInjection.description: Measures fuel pressure and sends data to the ECU.

EvaporationAndEmissionControl.name: Charcoal Canister
EvaporationAndEmissionControl.description: Traps fuel vapors from the tank to prevent emissions.

EvaporationAndEmissionControl.name: Purge Valve (EVAP Valve)
EvaporationAndEmissionControl.description: Controls flow of fuel vapors from canister to intake manifold.

EvaporationAndEmissionControl.name: Vent Valve
EvaporationAndEmissionControl.description: Regulates vapor pressure in the fuel tank.

EvaporationAndEmissionControl.name: Fuel Tank Pressure Sensor
EvaporationAndEmissionControl.description: Monitors fuel vapor pressure for emission control system.

FuelManagementElectronics.name: Fuel Pump Control Module
FuelManagementElectronics.description: Regulates voltage and operation of the electric fuel pump.

FuelManagementElectronics.name: Fuel Injector Driver
FuelManagementElectronics.description: Controls timing and duration of injector pulses.

FuelManagementElectronics.name: ECU Fuel Map
FuelManagementElectronics.description: Software algorithm managing air-fuel mixture and injection timing.

SupportingHardware.name: Fuel Tank Cap
SupportingHardware.description: Seals the tank and prevents fuel evaporation.

SupportingHardware.name: Fuel Pump Relay
SupportingHardware.description: Switches electrical power to the fuel pump.

SupportingHardware.name: Fuel Hose Clamps
SupportingHardware.description: Secures fuel lines to fittings and components.

SupportingHardware.name: Fuel Level Sensor
SupportingHardware.description: Measures fuel level in the tank and sends data to gauge.
